add_time.description: Shift a date by an amount and unit, like +3 days or -2 hours. Use a negative amount to go back in time. Handy for due dates, reminders, and expiry dates.
add_time.name: add_time

parameters.description: The starting date, in ISO format, like 2026-06-30 or 2026-06-30 09:30.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: How much to shift the date by. Use a negative number to subtract, like -2 to go back two units.
parameters.name: amount

parameters.description: The unit of time to add or subtract.
parameters.name: unit

returns.description: The new date and time as an ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC.

date_difference.description: Measure the elapsed time between two dates in a chosen unit (years, months, days, hours, minutes, or seconds). Months and years count complete calendar months and years, so a start date of 2022-07-03 is 4 years before 2026-07-03. The result is signed: positive when the end date is after the start date, negative when it's before. Unlike the Time until date action, which counts from now, this measures between two dates you provide.
date_difference.display_str_template: Get the difference between {0} and {1} in {2}
date_difference.name: date_difference

parameters.description: The date to measure from, in ISO format, like 2026-06-30 or 2026-06-30 09:30.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: The date to measure to, in ISO format, like 2026-06-30 or 2026-06-30 09:30.
parameters.name: end

parameters.description: The unit to measure the difference in.
parameters.name: unit

returns.description: The whole number of units from the start date to the end date, negative if the end date is earlier.

date_part.description: Pull a single component out of a date: the year, month, day of the month, month and day together, day of the week, hour, or minute. Returns a number for every part except day of the week, which returns the weekday name like Monday, and month and day, which returns text like 07-03. Use it for conditional logic on a date, such as acting only in December or only on the 1st, or compare the month and day of two dates to find anniversaries and birthdays.
date_part.name: date_part

parameters.description: The date to read from, in ISO format, like 2026-06-30 or 2026-06-30 09:30.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: Which component of the date to extract.
parameters.name: part

returns.description: The part of the date (in UTC) that was asked for: a number for the year, month, day of the month, hour or minute, the weekday name for the day of the week, or MM-DD text for the month and day.

format_date.description: Turn a date into a friendly format for emails, messages, or reports.
format_date.name: format_date

parameters.description: The date to make readable, in ISO format, like 2026-06-30 or 2026-06-30 09:30.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: Which preset to display the date in, for example a long date and time, just the date, just the time, or an ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: format

parameters.description: Defaults to your account timezone, or UTC if you haven't set one.
parameters.name: timezone

returns.description: The date as readable text, in the chosen format and time zone.

is_business_day.description: Check whether a date is a business day: a weekday that is not a public holiday.
is_business_day.display_str_template: Check if {0} is a business day
is_business_day.name: is_business_day

parameters.description: The date to check, like 2026-06-30.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: The region whose public holidays are excluded. US is currently the only supported region.
parameters.name: region

returns.description: Whether the date is a weekday that is not a public holiday in the region.

is_holiday.description: Check whether a date is a public holiday.
is_holiday.name: is_holiday

parameters.description: The date to check, like 2026-06-30.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: The region to check for public holidays. US is currently the only supported region.
parameters.name: region

returns.description: Whether the date is a public holiday in the region, or the weekday a weekend holiday is observed on.

is_weekend.description: Check whether a date falls on a weekend (Saturday or Sunday).
is_weekend.name: is_weekend

parameters.description: The date to check, like 2026-06-30.
parameters.name: date

returns.description: Whether the date falls on a Saturday or Sunday.

now.description: Get the current date and time.
now.display_str_template: Get the current date and time
now.name: now

returns.description: The current date and time as an ISO 8601 timestamp with milliseconds, in your account's time zone.

time_until.description: Find out how many seconds remain until a date and time.
time_until.name: time_until

parameters.description: The moment to count down to. Pick it from the field, or reference a variable with @ to count down to a date and time an earlier step produced.
parameters.name: date

returns.description: The whole number of seconds from now until the date, negative if it has passed.

parameters.description: Defaults to your account timezone, or UTC if you haven't set one.
parameters.name: timezone

returns.description: Today's date as YYYY-MM-DD, in the chosen time zone or your account's.

parameters.description: Defaults to your account timezone, or UTC if you haven't set one.
parameters.name: timezone

returns.description: Tomorrow's date as YYYY-MM-DD, in the chosen time zone or your account's.

unix_timestamp.description: Get the current time as a Unix timestamp: the number of seconds since January 1, 1970.
unix_timestamp.name: unix_timestamp

returns.description: The current time as whole seconds since January 1, 1970 (UTC).

weekday_name.description: Get the weekday for a date, like Monday or Saturday.
weekday_name.display_str_template: Get the day of the week for {0}
weekday_name.name: weekday_name

parameters.description: The date to look up, like 2026-06-30.
parameters.name: date

returns.description: The day of the week of the date (in UTC), such as Monday.

parameters.description: Defaults to your account timezone, or UTC if you haven't set one.
parameters.name: timezone

returns.description: Yesterday's date as YYYY-MM-DD, in the chosen time zone or your account's.

description: Get, format, and compare dates and times.
